notes.title: We're Almost There: Steam Release Roadmap
notes.content: [p][b]We're Almost There: Steam Release Roadmap[/b][/p][p]Just a few things remain before we're ready for the Steam release![/p][p][/p][p]⚠️ [b]Disclaimer:[/b] This roadmap is not final. We're still learning, and plans may change frequently. However, here's a broad overview of what we aim to include before launch:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45211109/45333e933c7b450a995a03d42fb43a2421cded31.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Endless Mode [/b](Done ✔️)[/p][list][*][p]The endless mode is already complete and fully functional[/p][/*][*][p]A new ant unit, [i]Dagger[/i], has been added[/p][/*][*][p]A new tutorial location, [i]The Field[/i], is now available[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Episodes System[/b][/p][list][*][p]With this update, each area will be split into 2-4 shorter levels[/p][/*][*][p]This will allow us to teach mechanics gradually, increase difficulty step by step, and help players avoid getting stuck and grinding too much[/p][/*][*][p]Players will be rewarded for collecting stars, and we'll use this to smoothly introduce new mechanics through bonus rewards[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]New Locations[/b][/p][list][*][p]The game currently has only 7 levels, but we’re expanding![/p][/*][*][p]We’re adding new enemies, mechanics, and challenges[/p][/*][*][p]While it’s too early to say which specific locations will make it to release, we’ve selected our favorite concepts to work on for the roadmap[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Festivals[/b][/p][list][*][p]We plan to take part in at least two Steam festivals to boost wishlist visibility and improve our launch[/p][/*][*][p]At the moment, the lineup of 2026 festivals is still unknown, so we’re unsure when we’ll be able to join the next Steam Next Fest 26[/p][/*][*][p]Our target release window is [b]Q1 2026[/b], but the exact date is still TBA[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Technical[/b][/p][list][*][p]We'll also need some time to implement Cloud Saves, Achievments and Controller Support. Its not done yet[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
